title: Roll Out the Thunder
transcription:
Roll Out The Thunder

Roll out the thunder boys,
We'll never go under boys.
We are the Cherry Valley Staff you see!
We've got the spirit, right!
We'll sing so you hear it, right!
We are the Cherry Valley Staff that's me.

We can hike a whole day through,
Row or paddle a canoe.
We can hike or swim or sail a boat,
O'er the ocean,

So let's roll out the thunder boys,
We'll never go under boys.
We are the Cherry Valley Staff you see!
We've got the spirit, right!
We'll sing so you hear it, right!
We are the Cherry Valley Staff that's me.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from photographed page spread. Nonsense syllables in 'Hucka' are especially uncertain.
